faqSection.faq1Question: How does integration with our existing tools work?
faqSection.faq1Answer: Our technical team helps you connect your ERP (SAP, Odoo, Salesforce) through our secure API. Integration takes about 2 weeks on average, with dedicated support.
faqSection.faq2Question: How long does it take to set up the CSE platform?
faqSection.faq2Answer: The platform can be up and running in 48 hours for the basic features. Full integration with your travel and CSE policies usually takes 1 to 2 weeks.
faqSection.faq3Question: Is the data hosted in Africa?
faqSection.faq3Answer: Yes, we offer local hosting in Africa (West or East region, depending on your preference) with GDPR and local regulatory compliance.
faqSection.faq4Question: How do you handle multi-country tax compliance for travel?
faqSection.faq4Answer: Our rules engine automatically applies each country's tax specifics (VAT, local taxes, exemption thresholds). Policies are updated in real time.
faqSection.faq5Question: Do you offer a mobile app for CSE benefits?
faqSection.faq5Answer: Yes, our iOS and Android apps let employees manage their bookings, expense reports and CSE benefits fully on the go.
faqSection.faq6Question: What support is included for business travel?
faqSection.faq6Answer: Support is included 24/7 via chat and email. Enterprise customers get a dedicated account manager and a 99.9% SLA.
faqSection.faq7Question: Can we customize our travel and CSE policies?
faqSection.faq7Answer: Absolutely. Our platform lets you configure policies by department, region or employee type, with customizable approval levels.
faqSection.faq8Question: How is employee data privacy handled?
faqSection.faq8Answer: We apply the data minimization principle, with AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit. Data access is strictly controlled through roles and permissions.
faqSection.faq9Question: What types of CSE benefits are available?
faqSection.faq9Answer: We offer a full catalog: digital gift cards, leisure and culture ticketing, local discount offers, holiday vouchers, and much more.
faqSection.faq10Question: How do you manage group travel bookings?
faqSection.faq10Answer: Our platform makes group travel easy to manage with dedicated features: group bookings, participant tracking, and budget management.

• Consumer mediator: CNPM – Consumer mediation (filing deadline: one year from the written complaint).
• Online dispute resolution platform: https://ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr (for European consumers, where applicable).

**Competent courts**
In the absence of an amicable agreement, any dispute relating to the validity, interpretation or performance of these legal notices will be submitted:
• To the courts of Paris (France) for customers based in the European Union.
• To arbitration under the rules of the CCJA (Common Court of Justice and Arbitration of OHADA) for customers based in West or Central Africa.
• For other countries, the Paris court remains competent notwithstanding multiple defendants or third-party claims.

privacyPage.afrikvoyageAfrikcseOnly:
At AfrikVoyage & AfrikCSE, we only collect the data necessary for the excellence of our services, segmented according to your use.

• AfrikVoyage: identity (last name, first name, email, position, department), travel preferences, passports/visas, payment data, expense receipts scanned by AI (OCR).
• AfrikCSE: choice of benefits (e.g. meal vouchers, sports subscriptions), use of ticketing, responses to satisfaction surveys.
• Performance data: carbon footprint calculation, CSR compliance KPIs, budget flow analysis.

We never collect sensitive data without explicit consent (e.g. health, except for specific travel insurance).
privacyPage.text2PurposesHowData: 2. Purposes: how your data powers the platform's intelligence
privacyPage.dataFuelAlgorithmsAlways:
Your data is the fuel for our algorithms, always in your interest:

• "Sam" AI engine: anticipates flight disruptions, automatically reschedules itineraries and hotels, and updates your calendars.
• Expense management: automation of the data flow to your ERP (SAP, Oracle, Odoo) for real-time financial reporting.
• Well-being & CSR: tracking of traveler health indicators (anonymized alerts) and reduction of the carbon footprint through low-impact itinerary recommendations.
• Security: behavioral analysis to detect and block abnormal access.
privacyPage.processDataFollowingBases:
We process your data on the following bases:
• Performance of the contract between your organization and AfrikVoyage/AfrikCSE (mandatory to provide the service).
• Legitimate interest: ensuring security, improving our algorithms (with minimization), and preventing fraud.
• Consent for personalization cookies, marketing sharing, or activation of beta features.
• Legal obligations (retention of tax receipts, etc.).
privacyPage.activeAccountDataEntire:
• Active account data: for the entire duration of the contractual relationship + 3 months (pre-archiving).
• Expense receipts (scanned): 10 tax years (in accordance with local legislation).
• Anonymized or pseudonymized data: kept indefinitely for statistical purposes.
• Cookies: 13 months maximum (except necessary ones, deleted at the end of the session).
privacyPage.text5SharingTransferControlled: 5. Sharing and transfer – Your controlled ecosystem
privacyPage.neverSellPersonalData:
We never sell your personal data. The only sharing is:
• With travel providers (airlines, hotels, GDS) to make your bookings.
• With benefit platforms (Netflix, Amazon, Sodexo) to activate your CSE credits.
• With your internal administrators (restricted access on a need-to-know basis).
• Transfers outside the EU governed by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) and a data protection assessment.

All sharing is end-to-end encrypted and subject to a confidentiality agreement.
privacyPage.text6SecurityCompliance: 6. Security and compliance – The foundation of absolute trust
privacyPage.certificationsGdprBuilt:
• Certifications: GDPR (built-in compliance) and SOC 2 Type II (independent annual audit).
• Sovereign hosting of your choice: OVHcloud (France) or Africa Data Centres (Johannesburg, Casablanca).
• Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit. Keys managed by an HSM (Hardware Security Module).
• Access control: zero human access by default. Sensitive data (passports) is only visible to algorithms, except for customer support with strong authentication and a dedicated session.
• Evidentiary archiving: our digital receipts are timestamped and electronically signed, in accordance with French law no. 2000-230 of March 13, 2000 and UEMOA legislation.
privacyPage.haveFullControlOver: You have full control over your preferences through our consent banner (accessible at any time at the bottom of the page). The categories are detailed alongside. You can withdraw your consent at any time.
privacyPage.text8RightsAccessControl: 8. Your rights – Access, control and portability
privacyPage.haveFollowingRightsWhich:
You have the following rights, which you can exercise directly from your dashboard or by contacting us:
• Right of access and rectification: view and correct your data in real time.
• Right to erasure: request the deletion of your data after the contractual relationship.
• Right to restriction: suspend certain processing (e.g. personalization cookies).
• Right to portability: retrieve a structured copy of your data (JSON/CSV).
• Right to object: refuse marketing sharing or use for predictive AI purposes (with no impact on the basic service).
• Right not to be subject to an automated decision: you can request a human review for any automatically cancelled booking.
privacyPage.afrikvoyageAfrikcse: AfrikVoyage & AfrikCSE: Protecting your data is not a constraint, it is the foundation of our platform of excellence.
privacyPage.canAlsoExerciseRight: You can also exercise your right

privacyPage.useCookiesEssentialPlatform: We use cookies that are essential to the platform's operation (authentication, Workspace Switcher) and, with your consent, analytics and personalization cookies.
privacyPage.canAlsoExerciseRights: You can also exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, portability) by email at <a1>dpo@afrikworkspace.com</a1> or via the contact form.
